title: Hospital Management Portal (HMP)
description: The Hospital Management Portal (HMP) is a secure, self-service platform for patients to manage their profiles, appointments, and medical records. It also provides doctors with tools for clinical schedule management and EHR updates, and administrators with oversight capabilities.
generatedDescription: A secure portal for hospital management, enabling patients to manage their health, doctors to streamline workflows, and administrators to oversee operations, ensuring HIPAA compliance and data integrity.

items.name: patient
items.description: Patients use the HMP to manage their personal profile, schedule and view appointments, and access their medical records and visit summaries securely.

items.name: doctor
items.description: Doctors use the HMP to manage their clinical schedules, view and update assigned patient Electronic Health Records (EHR), and track pending appointment requests.

items.name: admin
items.description: Administrators use the HMP to manage system users (patients and doctors), oversee all appointment activity, maintain system data integrity, and generate reports.

items.title: Patient Profile Management
items.description: Patients shall be able to securely update their personal information, contact details, and other profile-related data.

items.title: Appointment Scheduling and Management
items.description: Patients shall be able to schedule new appointments, view their upcoming and past appointments, and cancel existing appointments. The system must ensure doctor availability is respected during scheduling.

items.title: Medical Record Access for Patients
items.description: Patients shall be able to securely access their medical records and visit summaries, ensuring compliance with data privacy regulations.

items.title: Doctor Schedule Management
items.description: Doctors shall be able to manage their clinical availability, set their working hours, and view their daily/weekly schedules.

items.title: Electronic Health Record (EHR) Management for Doctors
items.description: Doctors shall be able to view and update the Electronic Health Records (EHR) of their assigned patients, including adding notes, diagnoses, and treatment plans.

items.title: Appointment Request Tracking for Doctors
items.description: Doctors shall be able to track and respond to pending appointment requests from patients, including approving or declining them.

items.title: Secure Patient-Doctor Messaging
items.description: The system shall provide a secure, encrypted, and auditable messaging channel for confidential communication between patients and their assigned doctors.

items.title: Reporting and Analytics Generation
items.description: Administrators shall be able to generate configurable reports and dashboards on appointment activity, user engagement, and communication metrics, with options to export data in CSV/PDF formats.

items.title: External EHR/LIS/Insurance Integration
items.description: The system shall integrate with existing hospital systems such as EHR, LIS, and insurance platforms using RESTful and/or FHIR-based APIs for data exchange.

items.title: Webhook Notifications for Events
items.description: The system shall send webhook notifications to external systems for significant events, such as appointment status changes and new messages.

items.title: Hospital Settings Configuration
items.description: Administrators shall be able to configure hospital-specific settings, including operating hours, holidays, and general policies.

items.title: Patient Consent Management
items.description: Patients shall be able to manage their consent preferences for data usage and privacy policies, and exercise their rights for data access, correction, or deletion.

items.title: PHI Access Audit Logging
items.description: The system shall maintain an immutable audit log of all access to Protected Health Information (PHI) for compliance with HIPAA and national data protection laws.

items.name: Patient
items.description: Represents a patient registered in the Hospital Management Portal.

items.name: Doctor
items.description: Represents a medical doctor practicing at the hospital.

items.name: Appointment
items.description: Represents a scheduled medical appointment between a patient and a doctor.

items.name: MedicalRecord
items.description: Stores a patient's medical record entry or visit summary, potentially including diagnoses, treatments, and notes.

items.name: Message
items.description: Represents a secure, auditable message exchanged between a patient and a doctor.

items.name: HospitalSetting
items.description: Stores configurable hospital-wide settings such as operating hours, holidays, and policies.

items.name: ConsentRecord
items.description: Records patient consent for data usage, privacy policies, and exercise of data rights.

items.name: scheduleAppointment
items.description: Handles the end-to-end logic for a patient scheduling an appointment, including checking doctor availability, validating time slots, and creating the Appointment record. It may also send notifications.

items.name: updateEHR
items.description: Allows a doctor to securely update a patient's Electronic Health Record, ensuring data integrity, versioning, and compliance. This function might also trigger external EHR synchronization.

items.name: sendMessage
items.description: Sends a secure and auditable message between a patient and a doctor, handling encryption and storing message content.

items.name: generateAppointmentReport
items.description: Generates a comprehensive report on appointment activities, including metrics like number of appointments, cancellations, and doctor utilization, based on specified filters.

items.name: syncEHRData
items.description: Synchronizes patient medical data with an external Electronic Health Record (EHR) system, typically triggered by updates to internal MedicalRecord entities.

items.name: sendAppointmentWebhook
items.description: Sends a webhook notification to configured external systems whenever an Appointment record is created, updated (e.g., status change), or deleted.

items.name: manageHospitalSettings
items.description: Allows administrators to update and manage hospital-specific configuration settings, such as operating hours, holidays, and general policies.

items.name: processPatientDataRequest
items.description: Handles patient requests for data access, correction, or deletion, ensuring compliance with privacy regulations and updating ConsentRecord status.

items.name: logPHIReadAccess
items.description: Records an audit entry whenever a MedicalRecord (containing PHI) is accessed, capturing who accessed it and when, for compliance purposes.

items.name: getDoctorAvailability
items.description: Retrieves the availability schedule for a specific doctor, considering their set working hours and existing appointments.

items.name: summarizeMedicalRecord
items.description: Summarizes a patient's medical record or specific visit summaries, extracting key information like diagnoses, medications, and treatment plans.

items.name: draftMedicalNote
items.description: Assists doctors in drafting medical notes for a patient's EHR based on provided symptoms, observations, and patient history.

items.name: answerPatientFAQ
items.description: Provides answers to common patient questions based on hospital policies, general medical information, or FAQs stored in a knowledge base.

items.name: analyzeAppointmentTrends
items.description: Analyzes appointment data to identify trends, such as peak hours, common reasons for visits, or cancellation rates, for administrative insights.

items.name: EHRSystem
items.description: Integration with an external Electronic Health Record (EHR) system for comprehensive patient data management. Requires RESTful or FHIR-based APIs for data synchronization (e.g., patient demographics, medical history, lab results).

items.name: LISSystem
items.description: Integration with a Laboratory Information System (LIS) for ordering lab tests and receiving results. Requires APIs for sending test requests and receiving structured results.

items.name: InsurancePlatform
items.description: Integration with insurance providers for patient eligibility verification, claim submission, and billing processes. Requires APIs for real-time checks and batch submissions.

items.name: Webhook
items.description: Generic outbound webhook service to notify external applications about significant events within the HMP, such as appointment changes or new messages. Requires a configurable endpoint URL and payload structure.

items.name: patientAssistantAgent
items.description: An AI agent that assists patients with managing their health journey, including appointment scheduling, understanding medical information, and answering common questions.

items.name: doctorAssistantAgent
items.description: An AI agent designed to support doctors in their clinical workflow, helping with EHR summarization, drafting medical notes, and managing patient communications.

items.name: adminReportingAgent
items.description: An AI agent for administrators to generate and analyze reports, identify operational trends, and gain insights into hospital performance.

items.title: Patient Dashboard
items.description: This module provides patients with an overview of their health information. They can view upcoming appointments, access their medical records and visit summaries, manage their personal profile, and initiate secure messages with their doctors. Used by: patient.

items.title: Doctor Dashboard
items.description: This module serves as the primary workspace for doctors. They can view and manage their clinical schedule, access and update patient EHRs, track pending appointment requests, and communicate securely with their patients. Used by: doctor.

items.title: Appointment Management (Admin)
items.description: Administrators use this module to oversee all appointment activities across the hospital. They can view, filter, and manage appointment statuses, resolve conflicts, and monitor overall scheduling efficiency. Used by: admin.

items.title: User Management (Admin)
items.description: This module allows administrators to manage all user accounts within the system, including patients and doctors. They can create new accounts, modify user profiles, assign roles, and deactivate accounts. Used by: admin.

items.title: Medical Records Viewer
items.description: This module provides a secure and detailed interface for both patients and doctors to view comprehensive medical records, including past visits, diagnoses, treatments, and lab results. Access is role-based. Used by: patient, doctor.

items.title: Secure Messaging Interface
items.description: A dedicated chat-like interface enabling confidential and auditable communication between patients and their assigned doctors. It supports text-based messages and ensures privacy. Used by: patient, doctor.

items.title: Reporting & Analytics Dashboard
items.description: Administrators access this module to view and configure various reports and analytical dashboards related to hospital operations, such as appointment trends, user engagement, and communication metrics. Data export options are available. Used by: admin.

items.title: Hospital Settings Configuration
items.description: This module allows administrators to manage and update hospital-wide configurable settings, including operating hours, holiday schedules, and general operational policies. Used by: admin.

items.title: Consent Management
items.description: Patients use this module to review and manage their consent preferences regarding data usage, privacy policies, and to exercise their rights for data access, correction, or deletion. Used by: patient.
